improvements: Text 7146 -> 4701 lines. Dead keccak-scratch stores, struct zeroing and call-buffer writes dropped (687 scratch stores -> 24). The free-memory-pointer fix decodes every escrow call (deposit, withdraw, approve, 709255a5, f93f1cd0), the three event payloads and the three returns that were raw memory (finding 2). The approve result check reads ext_call.return_data[0]. P1 (initialize's Initializable slot now 0xf0c5..00) and P6 (0x01ffc9a7.., 0x02dd7b..) are gone. A Panic(17) check dominated by '_121 > mem[_303]' is folded into SafeMath.sub in the approve/deposit/EscrowFunded arguments.
notes: Diff 7575 lines, reviewed by structure. Read in full: beforeCollection, reconcileProvider, the afterCollection prefix (getMaxNextClaim, AgreementReconciled, the removal branch), the specific starts of cancelAgreement (cancel 2a9f4dfe call first) and offerAgreement (offer call, return). A script compared each function's sequence of calls, logs, storage writes, reverts and returns, old vs new. They are identical apart from the newly named calls and the folded dominated Panic(17), one per inlined escrow update. The mem[64] chain was checked on every path in reconcileProvider and afterCollection, e.g. 'mem[64] = _100 + ceil32(_1) + ceil32(_5) + ceil32(_6) + ceil32(rds) + 192' and the struct addresses _238/_221/_690. The dropped mem[64] updates after the post-withdraw re-fetch ('_303 = mem[64]') are never read later. Uses of ext_call.return_data[0] stay in their call's scope. These paths are unreachable in execution here (escrow = 0x0), so they were checked by reading. Leftover partial call-buffer writes such as 'mem[mem[64] + 96] = 0x7a8df28b..' and 'mem[132] = _param1' (P8) remain, fewer than before. The diff's big hunk headers pair old cancelAgreement lines with new reconcileAgreement lines because the two are nearly identical.
summary: No regression. The free-memory-pointer and dead-store fixes cut the text by a third and decode every escrow call, event payload and return that round 1 found as raw memory. The struct-member naming (stor1/2/3), raw sha3 accesses and the getEscrowAccount name remain.
